run_audio_visual_separation: run the audio-visual model to separate mixed speech from two speakers using video and audio inputs
test_audio_normalize: test the audio_normalize function that normalizes audio samples to a target RMS level
test_clip_audio: test the clip_audio function that clips audio values to the range [-1, 1]
test_get_separated_audio: test the get_separated_audio function that reconstructs separated audio waveforms from model mask predictions
test_main: test the main entry point that loads models, processes audio-video data with sliding windows, and writes separated WAV outputs
